target.title: feat: add slash command picker in chat composer
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw has many slash commands, but the chat composer did not provide an in-context way to discover, filter, and select them. Users had to know command names ahead of time, and invalid slash input could still reach send-time flows without clear composer-side handling.

This PR adds a slash command picker that opens when the user types `/`, supports category switching between commands and skills, filters results as the user types, and validates slash-style input before sending.

## Evidence

- Added focused Swift coverage for slash command picker state and send-time validation in `OpenClawKitTests/ChatViewModelTests.swift`.
- Added iOS gateway coverage in `apps/ios/Tests/IOSGatewayChatTransportTests.swift` for the command catalog transport surface.
- Captured UI screenshots from the implemented picker states:
  - Full picker: https://github.com/VicZhang6/openclaw/blob/assets/slash-screenshots/docs/assets/slash-panel-all.png?raw=true
  - Commands tab: https://github.com/VicZhang6/openclaw/blob/assets/slash-screenshots/docs/assets/slash-panel-commands.png?raw=true
  - Skills tab: https://github.com/VicZhang6/openclaw/blob/assets/slash-screenshots/docs/assets/slash-panel-skills.png?raw=true

## Design Philosophy

Since OpenClaw has many slash commands, the picker appears directly from the chat composer instead of requiring a separate reference page or memorized command names. The UI keeps the command name, description, and category visible so users can choose quickly without losing message context.

### Key Features

- **Instant trigger**: Type `/` to open the floating picker
- **Category tabs**: Switch between Commands and Skills views
- **Live filtering**: Start typing to filter the list in real time
- **Rich metadata**: Each item shows its name, description, and category badge
- **Send-time validation**: Invalid slash input is intercepted before sending

### Screenshots

**Full picker - all commands and skills**
![Slash Panel All](https://github.com/VicZhang6/openclaw/blob/assets/slash-screenshots/docs/assets/slash-panel-all.png?raw=true)

**Filtered to commands only**
![Slash Panel Commands](https://github.com/VicZhang6/openclaw/blob/assets/slash-screenshots/docs/assets/slash-panel-commands.png?raw=true)

**Filtered to skills only**
![Slash Panel Skills](https://github.com/VicZhang6/openclaw/blob/assets/slash-screenshots/docs/assets/slash-panel-skills.png?raw=true)


## Follow-up Evidence for bb1dba00e6

- Fixed the catalog request to include the active agent context derived from `agent:<id>:...` session keys before calling `commands.list`.
- Softened client-side slash validation so uncataloged slash-prefixed text continues through `chat.send`; the Gateway remains the final parser/authorizer.
- Added focused coverage for non-default-agent catalog loading and uncataloged slash send-path behavior.
- Local verification:
  - `swift test --package-path apps/shared/OpenClawKit --filter "slash command"` passed.
  - `swift test --package-path apps/shared/OpenClawKit --filter "unknown leading slash"` passed.
  - `xcodebuild test -project apps/ios/OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClaw -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -only-testing:OpenClawTests/IOSGatewayChatTransportTests` passed.
  - `swift test --package-path apps/shared/OpenClawKit --filter ChatViewModelTests --no-parallel` still has existing async timeout failures outside the slash-command tests; all slash-command tests in that run passed.
